description: Replace the site's pages with an existing website's (Squarespace, Wix or anything else: its sitemap, or failing that the links between its pages, says which pages), word for word, at the same paths, with its images copied across. A Wiki.js or MediaWiki wiki becomes the site's wiki, word for word: the whole site, or with `at` the wiki under that path beside its pages, so a site and its wiki on two hosts come together as one. Runs in the background for a minute or two, and every write to the site is refused until it ends: poll get_site until `job.status` is no longer `running`; `failed` says why, and `done` lists its `notes` on pages it skipped or could not read, which are left as they were.

at.description: For a Wiki.js or MediaWiki wiki only: the path to put it under on a site of pages, e.g. wiki. Left out, the wiki is the whole site.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: import_site
title: Move a website in
